positions.name: Airbnb, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Q2 2026 beat-and-raise (reported Aug 6 AH): revenue $3.6B (+17% YoY), GAAP EPS $1.37 (~9.5% above consensus); record quarter. Raised FY26 revenue growth to 'at least mid-teens' (from low-to-mid-teens) and lifted FY26 adj EBITDA margin floor to 'at least 35.5%' (from 35%) on strong travel demand. Second guidance raise this year.
positions.driver: Clean double-raise breakout: pre-market ~$163.5 (+7.8%) clears the prior 52-week high (~$156.50) on record results — momentum with a fundamental floor. Profitable mega-cap (~$100B) with heavy free cash flow gives downside protection; entered under the 8-10% chase cap with a definable stop. Chosen over Cloudflare (+15%, past chase cap) and faded AH pops (SMCI +2%, CHYM ~flat).
positions.risks: Gap-fill risk if the breakout fails back toward the $151.64 prior close; rich valuation on a momentum name; broad-market risk-off around the jobs report; travel-demand/macro sensitivity; pre-market print above the dashboard's lagged Yahoo feed (151.64) — fill risk if regular-session open is lower.
